name: Wooing Danger
source:
You were just chilling on your balcony. Suddenly, you find yourself somewhere else, surrounded by people who claim to be aliens.

Whether they actually are aliens or not... you have to woo them to survive.

[From [url=https://ravee-mushroom.itch.io/wooing-danger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你原本只是在自家阳台上悠闲吹风，转眼间却莫名其妙出现在了陌生的地方，四周还围满了自称是外星人的家伙。

不管他们到底是不是真的外星人……为了活命，你都得想办法把他们追到手。

[摘自[url=https://ravee-mushroom.itch.io/wooing-danger]itch.io[/url]]
